versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Paper Doctor: an automated peer-review style critique and polishing tool for academic paper drafts.
- Provides comprehensive diagnostic feedback across 8 dimensions including structure, introduction, methodology, results, writing quality, references, figures/formatting, and venue fit.
- Supports analysis of PDF, LaTeX, and Markdown files with customizable scope, depth, venue standards, and language polishing options.
- Generates structured diagnostic reports highlighting critical issues, suggestions for improvement, and strengths.
- Offers interactive follow-up for in-depth analysis of specific sections and detection of missing references with optional web search.
- Features automated suggestions for language enhancement, structural reorganization, reference formatting, and figure caption improvements.
